title: Chebyshev Polynomials in the Physics of the One-Dimensional Finite-Size Ising Model: An Alternative View and Some New Results
content: For studying of the finite-size behavior of the Ising model under different boundary conditions we propose an alternative to the standard transfer matrix technique approach based on Abel\`{e}s theorem and Chebyshev polynomials. Using it we easily reproduce the known for periodic boundary conditions results for Lee-Yang zeros, the exact position space renormalization group transformation, etc., and extend them deriving new results for antiperiodic boundary conditions. Note that in the latter case one has a nontrivial order-parameter profile, which we also calculate, where the average value of a given spin depends on the distance from the seam with opposite bond in the system. It is interesting to stress that under both boundary conditions, the one-dimensional case exhibits Schottky anomaly.
